messages:
maria.g: Hey team — customer (acct: acme-inc) seeing blank graph frames in Console. Console panels return 500s from analytics API when time range > 12h. Happening on multiple dashboards.

support_bot: Autoreply: created ticket #INC-2024-987, pinging oncall.

kevin_h: Can you paste a failing request (headers + body)? Any reproducible curl?

maria.g: Yep, pasted below. This is the request Console makes when opening the dashboard: 

maria.g: curl -i -X POST https://analytics.api.redwood.internal/v1/query \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT time, sum(value) FROM metrics WHERE service='web' AND time >= now() - 24h GROUP BY time(1m)" , "downsample": "1m" }'

maria.g: Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error

maria.g: Body: {"error":"executor: query killed: timeout"} and console shows "graph failed to load (500)"

ops-lina: I pulled analytics-proxy logs for that trace_id. Proxy returned 502 to Console after upstream analytics-api closed the connection with 500. Upstream logs: 

ops-lina: [analytics-api] 2024-05-06T14:01:12Z ERROR query_runner.go:187 query killed: context deadline exceeded (timeout) trace_id=tr_6a9b

devex_raj: Is this limited to this customer or any dashboard hitting long-range queries?

maria.g: I've repro'd with my own org when selecting 24h+ and using >1m resolution. Short ranges (1h, 2h) are fine. Looks like endpoints that expand to large aggregation jobs are failing.

kevin_h: Quick checks I ran:
- node count and CPU on analytics-api pods looked normal initially.
- ClickHouse cluster has a few slow shards, some queries spiking CPU.
- KV cache hit rate dropped ~to 5% for that query pattern.

kevin_h: Hypothesis: long-range GROUP BY with small buckets floods runner and causes long tail; request hits internal per-query timeout and is cancelled -> 500 back to proxy.

devex_raj: Any recent deploys to analytics-runner or query planner?

ops-lina: We rolled a minor patch yesterday that changed the default downsample fallback behavior (PR #3217). The change can cause full-resolution plans for certain windowed queries instead of automatically downsampling to 5m. Rolling it back on a canary now.

maria.g: Customer impact: several dashboards blanking intermittently since ~13:50 UTC. They're on Dedicated but use hosted analytics.

support_bot: Noted SLA hit. Escalating to eng-analytics.

kevin_h: Temporary mitigations:
- In Console we can force downsample to 5m for big ranges (UI toggle).
- On the platform side, increase per-query execution timeout from 60s -> 90s as stop-gap.

devex_raj: I'm going to apply a Console patch that forces coarse downsample for >6h ranges and add a banner suggesting shorter resolution. Rolling to prod in 10m.

ops-lina: Canary of rollback applied to ring-a (2 pods). After rollback, kv cache hit rate for the test query jumped to 48% and we saw no query cancellations for a few repro runs.

kevin_h: Good. Would like an eng playbook item:
- Add query planner telemetry: sample generated plan size, estimated rows.
- Add graceful 429 fallback with cached sample points instead of 500.

maria.g: I've sent the customer a note with workaround (use 5m downsample) and ETA for fix. They're accepting temporary workaround but want root cause.

devex_raj: Root cause likely the planner change that prevented automatic downsampling for windowed GROUP BYs, which created much larger execution plans and overloaded runners -> timeouts. We'll keep rollback and patch planner to re-introduce conservative downsample heuristics.

maria.g: Thanks. I'll keep this thread updated. Opening customer follow-up in ticket INC-2024-987.

support_bot: Update: incident severity -> P2, assigned to eng-analytics (kevin_h, ops-lina).

kevin_h: Follow-up actions I committed:
- rolling back PR #3217 completely in next 30m
- add short-term timeout bump on analytics-api
- add a Console opt to force coarse downsample for large windows

maria.g: Confirmed with customer after rollback canary: two previously-failing panels now load (5m buckets). They reported performance improved.

devex_raj: Will draft postmortem and include mitigation timeline + planner tests.

maria.g: End of updates for now. :thumbsup:
